This '''male [[Rodian/Legends|Rodian]]''' was trained as a [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] in the [[New Jedi Order]]. During the [[Swarm War]] this individual was training to become a Jedi at the [[Jedi Academy (Ossus)|Ossus Academy]]. When [[Chiss/Legends|Chiss]] [[Aristocra/Legends|Aristocra]] [[Chaf'orm'bintrano]] visited the academy, the apprentice was partaking in a game of [[Skorch]]. He may also have been the Rodian seen at the [[Conclave on Zonama Sekot]].
